mapping.summary: AI sales insights and Power BI analysis in BC
claims: Figures are computed live by the Power BI engine using the signed-in user's identity
Ready-made sales report with net sales, gross profit, order income, backlog and expected net sales vs prior year
AI writes interpretation of what moved and why per report and KPI
Break down KPIs by categories, customers, salespeople or dimensions
Chat answers questions with live figures and shows the DAX queries run
Exports breakdown as live Excel pivot or PDF
Analysis mode on any Power BI semantic model
Copilot creates analyses from plain language
Applies model permissions together with row-level security
Works with Power BI Pro, no Premium capacity required
AI runs on customer's own Azure OpenAI resource (bring your own key)
Sales report needs a sales model built on navida sales template (BC2Fab or NAVBI)
Analysis users need a Power BI Pro license
Personal analysis tabs saved per user
